fields.title: Apple guides its March-quarter gross margin below 45% on January 28
fields.text: At its fiscal first-quarter report, projected for January 28, 2027, Apple guides gross margin for the March quarter with a midpoint below 45.0%: a second step down after the 45%-46% it guided for the December quarter, against 47.9% reported for September.
fields.resolution_source: Apple fiscal Q1 2027 earnings call and release

chances.note: Management warned 'that memory costs could rise beyond the December quarter, while supply constraints may affect Mac and iPad into next year', and September's 47.9% carried about a point of tariff refunds that will not repeat. Against that, the March quarter leans more to Services, Apple raised iPhone prices by about $100, and it has 'longer-term memory contracts'. A further step below 45% is somewhat less likely than holding the 45%-46% range: one chance in three.

passages: The pressure point is the coming quarter. Apple expects a 45% to 46% gross margin, compared with 47.9% in the quarter just reported. Gross margin is the share of sales left after direct product and service costs, before other business expenses.

Higher memory-chip and AI costs are part of the squeeze. The comparison also includes a benefit that will not necessarily repeat: tariff refunds lifted the reported quarter’s margin by about one percentage point.
At the same time, investors continue to weigh management’s warning that memory costs could rise beyond the December quarter, while supply constraints may affect Mac and iPad into next year.

to.title: Apple guides March-quarter gross margin at 45% to 46%
to.text: At its January 28, 2027 report Apple guides March-quarter gross margin with a midpoint from 45.0% to 46.0%: the squeeze from memory costs neither deepens nor eases.
to.resolution_source: Apple fiscal Q1 2027 earnings call and release

to.title: Apple guides March-quarter gross margin above 46%
to.text: At its January 28, 2027 report Apple guides March-quarter gross margin with a midpoint above 46.0%: price increases and Services mix outrun memory costs.
to.resolution_source: Apple fiscal Q1 2027 earnings call and release

chances.note: A rebound above the December-quarter range needs memory costs to stop rising within one quarter, against management's own warning. Possible through mix and the $100 iPhone price rise, but the least likely of the three: one in five.

shock.note: Bulls already 'brushed off near-term memory margin headwinds' and the shares sit near a record, so proof that margins have turned adds less than a further fall would take away: 3% beyond what the shares would otherwise do.

The first step down in margin guidance cost 1.9% the next day (to $331.90 on Nov 3) before the shares rallied with the market. They now trade near a record after gaining 12% beyond the factors since Oct 1 (window), with KeyBanc calling them 'at the point of extreme overvaluation' and short interest up 10%. A second step down, showing the squeeze is not one quarter long, is worth about 5% beyond what the shares would otherwise do.
